observed_gaps.observation: EntityState stores ID, NPC, tile, orientation, sequence/timing, player flag and definition size. Its placement derives local coordinates as tile_delta*128 + size*64 and clamps the draw plane. This is a draw placement, not an observed native logical/render focus or camera-query footprint.

camera_source returns coherent actor/world/scene context and rendered placement, but deliberately leaves focus/effects absent with explicit reasons. Root code qualification did not invent those producers or remove the normal-entry fence.

The original camera probes supplied controlled logical/render coordinates and a zero-footprint player. They explicitly did not measure actor movement interpolation. Those fixture values cannot become production tile-centre, render-position or zero-footprint defaults.

Source effect channel fields and arithmetic are identified, but active-effect native trace scenarios are zero. Explicit phase and source-compatible random samples are required when active; neither render-time-derived phases nor an unproved inactive fallback is allowed.
